name: Lateral Neck Stretch
steps: Sit or stand tall and relax both shoulders.
Tip one ear toward the shoulder on that side until you feel a gentle stretch along the other side of your neck.
Let the opposite shoulder stay low and keep your chin facing forward.
Hold the stretch calmly with relaxed breaths on one side, then release gently and switch sides.
tips: Keep your gaze facing straight ahead rather than turning your chin up or down.
Let the weight of your head provide the stretch and stop if you feel pain or tingling.
